glossEn: any age prior to the legal age
note: any age prior to the legal age。法律义。线索：in one's minority（未成年时期）。**注意这个义项与「少数」毫无关系**，是借「小」引申的法律术语。极罕见。

glossEn: a group of people who differ racially or politically from a larger group of which it is a part
note: a group of people who differ racially or politically from the majority。线索：an ethnic minority / minority rights。

glossEn: being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts
note: being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts。线索：a minority opinion / the minority party。**注意与 majority 相反的对应关系：a minority of = 一小部分（少数），不是「大多数」。**
